summary: Iter73 verified all three requested features end-to-end: (1) Pre-Order backend flow — SKU marked out_of_stock via admin /status endpoint, /calculate rejects without is_preorder (400 as expected), /calculate with is_preorder+accept_preorder_terms returns exact 50% token_amount_inr, correct balance_due_inr, terms_version='PRE-ORDER-V1-2026-02', and terms_text containing all mandated clauses (non-refundable, non-cancellable, manufacturing defect, seal, damage). Missing accept_preorder_terms returns 400. /order creates the preorder record (verified in db.b2b_orders: is_preorder=true, terms_version stamped, token_amount_inr=50% of grand_total). preorder-receipt.pdf endpoint returns application/pdf, %PDF header, %%EOF trailer, size >3kB. Non-preorder receipt request returns 400. (2) Frontend CSV filter panel — visited /admin/b2b/inventory with an admin session cookie, clicked 'Export Log (CSV)' → filter panel opened with all 3 controls + download button, 11 product options populated, selecting a product + from=2026-02-01 + to=2026-02-28 correctly emitted the download request URL /api/admin/b2b/inventory/log/export.csv?product_id=bold-bakhoor-b2b&from_date=2026-02-01&to_date=2026-02-28. Backend CSV endpoint tested independently with synthetic log rows: product_id filter excludes other SKUs, date filter excludes March row when from/to constrained to Feb, unfiltered request returns all rows. (3) Monthly rewards digest — /admin/settings/integrations/config lists new accountant_email slot; PUT persists it. /admin/b2b/inventory/rewards-digest/send-now (admin auth) returns {sent, failed, month}. Scheduler boot log line 'Monthly rewards digest scheduler started' present in /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log (5 occurrences). All 12 preexisting unit tests (test_preorder_monthly_digest.py) still 100% pass. 4/4 new integration tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Sanity: PreOrderModal component built but not wired into retailer catalog — flagged by main agent as follow-up ticket, not a bug.

Minor: /order response shape for pre-orders should ideally expose token_amount_inr + balance_due_inr at the top level (currently derivable but requires a DB lookup in the integration test). Not blocking — receipt PDF carries the values.

Nit: b2b_orders.calculate_b2b_order returns 500 (TypeError) when db.retailer_sessions.expires_at is stored as a datetime object rather than an ISO string (fromisoformat call at routers/b2b_orders.py:91). Existing sessions from prior iterations always used ISO strings so no production impact, but a defensive isinstance check would harden it. Documented for main agent.
